Selected Scheme version, applicability and raw AnswerValue coordinates need reviewed maps to governed Value identities and immutable exact subject-revision Assignments.
Distinct operational Purpose identities need reviewed semantic agreement; differing label/question strings or owners do not prove meaning distinction.

Inherited unique-distinction OR recorded-dependencies, boundary schema-rule/residue alternatives and target-specific axis meaning need actual precedence review; do not copy sibling canonical-label policy as an unreferenced source assertion.
Optional statistics/no-data review and Shannon/Hilbert/contextuality registers need explicit extensions; no independence or consistency theorem from one word.
Allowed selections, effect/Kind maps and before-downstream ordering need policy/temporal review; toy coordinate states are not runtime mutations or authorization.
Shared D22 lineage, normalized owner/carrier identity, fifteen authored uses and jointly aligned meaning remain unresolved.
